text:
anya: Quick preflight — webinar (Tue 11am PT) + launch post going live same day. Need a concise SEO checklist: keywords for launch post and replay, JSON-LD schema for webinar/video, internal link plan from Resources hub, and an redirects handoff for old campaign links. Who can own which piece?

mike: I can own redirects. Question: replay will be gated — do we canonicalize to gated URL or public teaser landing?

elaine: Recommendation: canonical -> public teaser blog post, gated replay behind CTA. That gives search visibility for the narrative and avoids duplicate index issues.

sam: I’ll map target keywords. Thinking: 1) "large-model inference latency" 2) "LLM inference cost optimization" 3) "enterprise LLM deployment best practices" — will do short-tail + long-tail variations per section.

anya: Nice. Also need meta description / benchmark narrative summary (one-sentence hero for SERP). Sam can you draft that?

sam: Yep. Drafted meta: "How Redwood reduced LLM latency by 3x while cutting per-token cost — lessons from our production benchmark and a live webinar." Will iterate.

elaine: I'll draft JSON-LD for both the teaser and the gated replay (VideoObject + Event). Quick snippet for the teaser page: 
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Reducing LLM inference latency: benchmark & playbook",
  "startDate": "2026-03-31T18:00:00Z",
  "location": {"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.com/webinar/reducing-inference-latency"},
  "performer": {"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"},
  "description": "Live webinar and replay covering benchmark narratives and deployment playbooks."
}
```
I’ll attach VideoObject on the gated replay page pointing to the hosted transcript (non-indexed) and include a teaser schema on the public post.

mike: Redirects: old campaign had /webinar/latency-2025 -> new teaser at /webinars/latency-benchmark-2026. For the gating flow we want campaign links to land on teaser with UTMs then funnel to gated form. nginx rewrite example: 
```nginx
# permanent redirect old campaign to new teaser
rewrite ^/webinar/latency-2025$ /webinars/latency-benchmark-2026?utm_source=old_campaign&utm_medium=email permanent;
# preserve legacy tracking param X
if ($arg_x) {
  rewrite ^/legacy/(.*)$ /webinars/latency-benchmark-2026?referer=$arg_x redirect;
}
```
Use 301 for long-term canonical moves except when migrating preview pages then 302 temporarily.

anya: Perfect. For internal linking: we need 3 anchor placements from Resources hub: 1) /docs/inference-performance -> link to teaser in a 'Benchmarks' section, 2) /solutions/enterprise -> link in 'Deployments' paragraph, 3) /blog/ops -> add inline CTA to webinar. Can we get owners?

elaine: I’ll add the anchor in /docs/inference-performance and /blog/ops. Sam — can you add the /solutions/enterprise link to the copy deck?

sam: On it. Also recommending anchor text variations: "LLM inference benchmarks", "inference cost optimization", and "enterprise LLM deployments" to reduce over-optimization.

seo-bot: Reminder: run pre-index check 24h before launch (robots.txt, canonical tags, hreflang if needed). Filing scan ticket: MARKETING-SEO-478.

mike: Logging redirects in the central redirect sheet: https://docs.redwood.com/marketing/redirects (I added rows for legacy -> teaser). Also will push preview 302s today then swap to 301 after 72h if traffic stable.

anya: Owners recap: Mike = redirects + redirect sheet; Elaine = JSON-LD + anchors on docs & blog; Sam = keyword mapping + meta + solutions link; SEO-bot = pre-index scan; Anya = oversee messaging and webinar page copy. Deliverables due EOD Fri so engineering can QA.

elaine: I’ll paste the final JSON-LD and schema checklist in the doc by Friday noon. :thumbsup:

sam: Will share keyword mapping spreadsheet + meta drafts by Friday.

mike: Will set up 302s tonight and post confirmation in the redirect sheet.

anya: Great — thanks team. Small ask: please add two example CTAs for the teaser (short) and the blog (long-form CTA). I’ll consolidate. :party_parrot:
